selected_scenario.case_name: Venezuela-PDVSA sanctions, oil cash flow and creditor realisation
selection_rationale: Farthest from pilot participants' lived context, minimising topical contamination during fieldwork.

The programme's only instability case (37.5% pure-Nash share, positive maximum regret 0.11, seed-sensitive strategy selection in Study 009V) - gives the A1-A4 comparison ladder its strongest discriminating power.
Scoring restricted to directional mechanism class and equilibrium status per programme volatility-marker discipline; point magnitudes are never scored.

freeze_root_definition: sha256 of sort(ascii)-ordered lines '<relpath>  <sha256>' over frozen_files, newline-terminated, LF endings.
binding_ordering: 1. This freeze is published before the first consent is taken.
2. Participants never see C3 during fieldwork (no battery item, no interview prompt).
3. After fieldwork closes, agent configurations A1-A4 are frozen and their C3 predictions are produced, hashed and locked (prediction_lock_sha256 recorded here later).
4. Only after prediction lock does a final reveal session show participants C3; participant-majority becomes the human reference target.
5. Exactly one scoring pass against participant-majority and (if available) realised outcomes; every attempt including nulls and conflicts is retained.

prediction_lock.note: Populate prediction_lock_sha256 after step 3 of binding_ordering. Do not substitute synthetic values.

authority_boundaries: This freeze creates no canonical V34.0 ledger rows and grants no forecasting permission beyond this pilot's own scoring pass.
All agent outputs on C3 remain SIM-classified regardless of score.
No revision of RQ-621 frozen formulas or holdout handling is authorised by this document.
